title: LinkedIn Company Posts Scraper (No Cookies)
description: Scrape LinkedIn company posts without requiring cookies.

company.title: Company
company.description: LinkedIn company URL (https://www.linkedin.com/company/google), username/slug (google), or company name (Google LLC).

fileName.title: File Name
fileName.description: Tag name for this run. Used to identify your output file. Example: google-posts-june

maxPosts.title: Max Posts Per Company
maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to scrape. Set to 0 for unlimited.

postsAfterDate.title: Scrape Posts After Date
postsAfterDate.description: Only scrape posts published after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to get all posts.

includeReposts.title: Include Reposts
includeReposts.description: Set to true to include reposts in results. Set to false for original posts only.

orderId.title: Order ID (Optional)
orderId.description: Optional order ID to tag this run. Useful for tracking requests.
